title: The First 10 SaaS Customers
audience: Early SaaS founders who have launched and need a focused customer-learning process.
shortDescription: Acquire and learn from the first ten paying customers.
coreOutcome: Create early customer conversations, purchases, and learning loops.
problem: A launched product does not create its own reliable path to early customers.
situation: The product exists, but acquisition is still a collection of experiments without disciplined learning.
commonFailure: Chasing scale too early hides the direct feedback needed to understand why early buyers act or decline.
methodology: Choose a narrow market, run direct acquisition, support activation, and learn from every decision.
capabilities: Turn early customer behavior into product and message decisions
whoItsFor: Launched SaaS products seeking their earliest paying customers
whoItsNotFor: Anyone interpreting the number ten as a purchase guarantee

seo.title: The First 10 SaaS Customers | Prospect Foundry
